node.name: spawn_entity
node.args: -topic=/robot_description -entity $(var entity_name) -x $(var init_x_position) -y $(var init_y_position) -z $(var init_z_position) -R $(var init_roll_angle) -P $(var init_pitch_angle) -Y $(var init_yaw_angle)

executable.cmd: ros2 run ros_esc encoder_node /joint_states $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter --joint_names $(var joint_name_1)
ros2 run ros_esc rotate_frame_node $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc sensor_pose_node /odom $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc cost_function_node $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var cost_function_config_filepath)

ros2 run ros_esc filter_node $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter --filter_file $(var filter_config_filepath) --append_encoder_data $(var input_encoder_data_to_filter)

ros2 run ros_esc controller_node $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter /cmd_vel $(var controller_config_filepath)

ros2 run ros_esc data_collection_node $(var data_collection_filepath) $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath) $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath) $(var cost_function_config_filepath) $(var filter_config_filepath) $(var controller_config_filepath) $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter $(var live_plot_mode)
